browser.policy: Passing scenarios from the full desktop/touch run, with focused reruns of the corrected War scenario and destroyed-health styling assertion. All runs used this application tree.

campaign.policy: 4 disjoint formal shards. Each includes all sixteen real-state negative controls and immutable application/checker guards. Full Phase 3 FRAMES expectations exclude Citadel and are verified against real snapshots and IronVowScene.models; runtime Workshop and shield catalogs are dynamically compared. Assignments, observed loadouts and commanded attacks are separate. Lion remains in its dedicated checker and is required only when the final-ready flag is enabled. All-weapon landed-contact evidence remains in scene-combat reports. No device performance claim.

automatedCareerSample.policy: Current body-priority targeting and earned Trident/Watchman refits

limits.performance: Software-rendered behavioral and geometry checks provide no native-device performance measurement
